{{Top|leg}}
The '''Wroonian Guilds''' were a collection of guilds that operated on [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]]. They offered numerous services to the visitors of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The [[Salvage Guild]], the [[Guild of Armament Distributors]], the [[Guild of Glorious Mercenaries]], the [[Guild of Honorable Technicians]], the [[Spice Shippers Fellowship]] and the [[Contracts Guild]] were among the numerous guilds.
